ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the B3-1 Community Shopping
District symbols as shown on Map No. 9-K

in the area bounded by:
A line 125’ north of and parallel to Warwick Avenue; the public alley next east of and
parallel to North Cicero Avenue; a line 100’ north of and parallel te Warwick Avenue;

North Cicero Avenue.

To those of a C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 3745 N. Cicero Avenue
